self.title: Cycle 32 · Stoichiometric Submatrices and Chemical Memory in Autocatalytic Networks

detail.title: Stoichiometric Submatrices and Chemical Memory in Autocatalytic Networks
detail.summary: This cycle investigates autocatalytic reaction networks and stoichiometric submatrix conditions for chemical memory using collected peer evidence. We revise notebook-autocatalytic-memory-1 to incorporate exact findings on stoichiometric criteria distinguishing true history-dependent memory states from transient persistence.
